title: You don't need React: creating a minimal UI library in Vanilla JavaScript
summary: An educational article demonstrating how to build a lightweight UI library from scratch using pure Vanilla JavaScript, showing the fundamental concepts behind reactive UI rendering without relying on heavy frameworks like React.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how to create simple reactive UI components without the overhead of React or similar frameworks.
why_valuable: Helps developers understand core UI library internals and make informed decisions about when to use lightweight solutions vs full frameworks.
